messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] removing lib/boost_1.52.0/boost/fusion/adapted/.DS_Store
parts:
The .DS_Store files are introduced by the Mac OS.

They definitely shouldn't be checked in. They could
come from somebody doing an add at too high a level.

They're in our .gitignore file, so I'm not sure
how someone would've added them. Hard to believe
Boost would've erroneously distributed the, either.

- Bob
